verdict.rationale: Semgrep supports automated, event-triggered scanning (CI on push/PR, pre-commit hooks, and 'Managed Scans' that bulk-onboard repos without CI changes) which lets scans run autonomously in the background once configured. However, there is no evidence of AI-agent-style autonomous task orchestration beyond triggered scans — no scheduling/orchestration beyond CI events, no evidence of self-directed remediation or multi-step agentic workflows. Missing for 10: evidence of autonomous agent-driven remediation/orchestration beyond event-triggered scans, scheduling capabilities, and independent confirmation that Managed Scans truly run unattended at scale.
